categoryModal.depoisDeCriadaVoce: Once created, you connect the groups that can see its documents.

expiryAlertConfigSection.avisaQuemTemAcesso: Notifies anyone with access to this category through the rules map when a document is close to expiring. The document owner is always notified.
expiryAlertConfigSection.avisarComAntecedenciaDe: Notify this many days in advance
expiryAlertConfigSection.continuarAvisandoDepoisDe: Keep notifying after expiry (use negative numbers above, e.g. -7)
expiryAlertConfigSection.marcarGruposLimitaO: Selecting groups limits the notice to them. A group without permission to see the category in the rules map gets nothing, even if selected here.
expiryAlertConfigSection.nenhumGrupoDocumentalCadastrado: No document group registered. Without groups, only the document owner is notified.
expiryAlertConfigSection.nenhumGrupoMarcadoTodos: No group selected: every group with read access to this category will be notified.
expiryAlertConfigSection.umAvisoPorMarco: One notice per milestone. Use 0 to notify on the expiry date itself.

extractionConfigDrawer.abaixoDissoAExtracao: Below this, the extraction goes to review instead of standing on its own.
extractionConfigDrawer.comoODocumentoE: How the document is named on arrival, and from what confidence the extraction stands without review.
extractionConfigDrawer.ePorEstesTermos: These are the terms by which the analysis recognizes a document as belonging to this category.

governanceDetailDialog.conexaoPendenteSalveO: Connection pending. Save the map to apply it on the server.

governanceScoreboard.peopleReached: <count>{{reached}}</count> of {{total}} people reach at least one category through a group. Administrators see everything.

groupModal.asPessoasEntramNo: People join the group from the Users screen.

rulesPage.naoFoiPossivelCarregar: Could not load the rules right now.
